## Checklist

- [ ] One concern only; no unrelated refactors
- [ ] User-visible strings are in `strings.xml`
- [ ] Colours, type, spacing and motion use the tokens in `ui/theme`
- [ ] Icon-only controls have content descriptions
- [ ] Touch targets are at least 48 dp
- [ ] No new dependency (or the dependency was approved and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is updated)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes
- [ ] README updated if setup, permissions or behaviour changed
